resources.string: Android restricts background activity. Export may pause or fail when you switch apps or lock the screen.
Background limits cannot be confirmed. Export may pause or fail when you switch apps or lock the screen.
Always ignore only hides this reminder; it does not change system settings.
Open App info → Battery / background usage, then choose Unrestricted or Allow background activity (names vary by OS version).
vivo / iQOO: Open App info → Battery / background power use, then allow background activity or high background power use (names vary by OS version).
OPPO / realme / OnePlus: Open App info → Battery / power management, then allow background activity (names vary by OS version).
Xiaomi / Redmi / POCO: Open App info → Battery saver / background settings, then choose No restrictions (names vary by OS version).
System settings could not be opened. Open Settings manually and find Filmroom battery or background usage.
The standard Android background checks passed. This does not confirm that every manufacturer restriction is off.
Returning to the app does not start an export. Continue to review export options, or cancel to adjust settings first if restrictions remain.
